Marconi Sailing Club www.marconi-sc.org.uk Club Notices Club Secretary WORKING PARTIES – SATURDAY 7TH MARCH & SATURDAY 14TH MARCH 2020 This is your chance to shake off those winter blues while performing some useful jobs for the club. Pre-season working parties have been arranged for Saturday 7th March and Saturday 14th March. There will be the usual variety of tasks both indoors and out so please bring some tools, garden implements, etc. Sort out your gardening gloves and marigolds and join in the fun at Stansgate. Complementary soup, rolls, tea and coffee will be available for the workers in the clubhouse. ACCESS CARDS (‘GATE KEYS’) As the existing access cards have been in use for some years it is proposed to issue new cards to all members; probably in March. You do not need to do anything, your new card(s) will be sent to you by post. In the meantime, please continue to use your old card (s). EMPLOYMENT OF CONTRACTORS BY MEMBERS – CONTRACTORS ACCESS TO SITE Members are reminded that if they bring contractors on site at Stansgate they and their contractors must comply with the current issue of code of practice MSCP54 (Employment of Contractors by Members). This document is currently at Issue 5. Copies are available on the MSC website (Members Section/Document Library), in the clubhouse or from Ray Ball via email. Please note that contractors must be met on site by the member to comply with MSCP54 Section 3.6 and to avoid the contractor having a wasted journey. ONGOING CHANGES If you move home, change phone number, email address or boat(s) please remember to tell the Membership Secretary as soon as possible. Do not wait until the end of the year when incorrect invoices may be issued. It makes a tremendous amount of extra work for people who are giving their time for you. If you buy or sell boats the Club needs to know. The Membership Secretary maintains a database of all boats kept at Stansgate and, in the case of dinghies and catamarans, their boat park space identification number. If you propose bringing a cruiser to Stansgate or changing your cruiser the Mooring Secretary needs to be consulted in advance. DISPLAYING OF BOAT ‘STICKERS’ Members are supplied with 2020 boat fee stickers with their renewal packs and are required to display them prominently so that checks can be made. Please ensure that your boat(s) display the correct stickers. Car stickers are not being provided. SAILING, CAMPING & EVENTS CALENDAR The full sailing and camping programme for 2020 is published in the 2020 yearbook which was sent out with your renewal pack. The programme is also on the MSC website and dates of events are on the MSC portal https://member.marconi-sc.org.uk/login. Please note that working parties and the club AGM will be held on Saturdays in 2020 as they were in 2019. CAMPING FORTNIGHT & CADET WEEK 2020 Camping Fortnight 2020 will start on Saturday 25th July and end on Sunday 9th August; the last camping night being the night of Saturday 8th August. Cadet Week 2020 will run from Monday 27th July to Friday 31st July with the Cadet Regatta and prizegiving being held on Saturday 1st August. Camping Fortnight application forms will be found in this issue of Navigans. Please note that the Camping Fortnight application forms do not reserve a place in Cadet Week. Cadet Week application forms must be submitted separately [Ed: Cadet Week application forms will be available a little later in the year] MEETING DATES – HAVE YOUR SAY Your 2020 yearbook has the dates of the board, management committee and sailing subcommittee meetings for 2020 on Page 44. If you have any issues or concerns that you wish to be raised at one of these meetings please email to me in the first instance. I will then forward to the appropriate committee chairman. We started bowling at 19.45 and finished at 22.45. It was interesting to see that after the first game Roger had over 103 points and six players had 80 or over points. The ladies were one point apart at 88 and 87. We had had a light tasty meal after the first game at reserved tables. In the second game four players had over 100 points and two over 90. Penny won the Ladies prize, with a score of 201. The Men's prize was won by Roger with a score of 198 and the runner up Malcolm had a score of 189. Julie, Bryan and Nigel all finished with 180 or over. John, Mick and Dennis also had respectable scores. March 2020 Navigans 4

Dennis Dear Marconi Keelboat Academy – Launched ABOUT THE MARCONI KEELBOAT ACADEMY The Marconi Keelboat Academy (MKA) is designed to support young people aged between 14 and 24 in developing the skills needed to sail and race keelboats, whether for pleasure or racing at club or national level. Sailing keelboats requires teamwork, leadership skills, project management, physical fitness and the ability to communicate clearly under pressure. The MKA programme seeks to develop these areas equipping trainees with the essential skills that will benefit them both in their sailing and in the wider world. The MKA mirrors the model of the British Keelboat Academy which MKA members might select to progress to on reaching 18 years of age. The MKA will offer in the region of 25+ individuals a one year programme in 2020 covering all aspects of racing, training, boat and personal preparation. Participating in a range of events during the season, the MKA )nfl;‘ sailors will receive coaching on board the clubs fleet of SB20’s from a variety of experienced sailing coaches and keelboat racers. In addition to this, sailors will receive training ashore spanning subjects including, racing rules, rig tuning and sail trim. All members of the MKA will be invited to participate in the end of season MKA regatta whilst a team of four will be selected to represent the club at the Youth event of the British Keelboat League in Cowes during June. MARCONI KEELBOAT ACADEMY SKILLS DEVELOPMENT All sailors from the MKA will be encouraged to develop their skills in all positions on a boat. Foredeck includes: Pole, Mast and Pit. Trimmer includes: Pit, Spinnaker Trim, Jib Trim and Main Trim. Afterguard includes: Main Trim, Helm and Navigation/Tactics. Each Sailor will be given training in the following areas: Ak Boat Preparations for event and conditions – Sails, controls, rig settings, safety, weather forecast interpretation Boat Launching & Recovery – procedures, equipment handling, safety Sail and rig controls – Halyards, down-haul, out-haul, gnav, traveller, cars, pole, backstay Sail trimming – Jib Trim and Main Trim. Balance – helm, sail trim, crew position Boat handling – speed control, mooring pick up, MOB under sail Asymmetric spinnaker handling – working as a team, boat handling Short Course Racing – crew work, boat handling Long Course Racing – basic navigation, boat speed March 2020 Navigans 5

MSC-DOC-2020-10-agm-notice.pdf: Marconi Sailing Club Ltd Annual General Meeting 2020 Notice is hereby given that the Annual General Meeting of Marconi Sailing Club Ltd will be held on Saturday 28th November 2020 starting at 11:00 hrs. Please note that due to the Covid crisis there will not be a traditional AGM held in the clubhouse at Stansgate. There will be a virtual AGM held online. The arrangements will be communicated to members in due course. RESOLUTIONS Any member wishing to submit a resolution to be presented at the AGM should send it to the Company Secretary by email secretary@marconi-sc.org.uk to arrive not later than the 31st October 2020. Any such proposal shall be proposed and seconded by Single, Retired Single, Family, Retired Family, Young Adult, Senior, Senior Life or Honorary Life members. The proposer of the resolution should type out the resolution and agree the wording with the seconder and get their support. The proposer should then email the resolution to the Company Secretary together with the name of the seconder. Summary: i) Compose the proposed AGM resolution ii) Email the proposed resolution to your seconder. Seek their agreement to the wording and their support. Ask them to reply to your email with their agreement to second the resolution. iii) Send the completed email string together with the AGM resolution to the company secretary by 31st October 2020. NOMINATIONS Any member wishing to be nominated for election to one of the posts listed below * shall submit a completed nomination # to the Company Secretary by email secretary@marconi-sc.org.uk to arrive not later than the 31st October 2020. Any nomination shall be proposed and seconded by Single, Retired Single, Family, Retired Family, Young Adult, Senior, Senior Life or Honorary Life members. # Circulating paper copies of the nomination form in the traditional way amongst proposers and seconders is neither desirable nor necessary. Nominees should seek the agreement of their proposer and seconder by an email string before finally sending the email with the nomination to the Company Secretary. This year the agreement of the proposer and seconder on an email will be accepted in place of signatures. Summary: i) Select the role(s) you wish to stand for at the AGM ii) Email your proposer seeking their support. Ask them to reply to your email with their agreement to propose. iii) Then forward the email to your seconder seeking their support. Ask them to reply to your email with their agreement to second. iv) Send the completed email string to the company secretary by 31st October 2020.

If two members intend to stand as a ‘job share’ for a role, please supply the names of both nominees but only one proposer and one seconder are needed. If you have any questions regarding the procedures for resolutions or nominations, please contact Ray Ball secretary@marconi-sc.org.uk or by telephone (see yearbook). The positions that will be elected at the AGM are: President Vice Presidents (* Vice Presidents are recommended by the directors and elected at the AGM) The Board of Directors Commodore Vice Commodore 1 (Club Equipment & Moorings) Vice Commodore 2 (Clubhouse & Precincts) Rear Commodore 1 (Sailing Sub-Committee; Cadet Training) Rear Commodore 2 (Events & Social; Camping) Honorary Treasurer (Finance & Strategic Planning) The Management Committee Bar Manager Clubhouse Manager Camping Manager Sailing Secretary Rowing Captain Moorings Secretary Plant Co-ordinator (name changed from Tractor Co-ordinator to describe the role more accurately) Social Manager Publicity Co-ordinator Membership Secretary New Member Liaison Officer East Coast Piers Race Secretary Navigans Editor Webmaster Committee Members (Note that the Board Members and Vice Presidents also serve on the Management Committee)
